sourceTitle: Service areas and their assigned workers
observedAudience: Owners and office staff who schedule, dispatch and record field jobs. No developer knowledge is needed.
observedLearningOutcomes: Define a service area with a clear boundary and a parent area where one exists.
Place a worker in an area as main base, backup area, or temporary cover.
Explain why an oversized area slows scheduling and dispatch.
